envelope.description: Bind installed consumers to the verified external runtime

body.title: Bind installed consumers to the verified external runtime
body.summary: Wire manager/terminal entry, TUI/Retry launch selection, production peer dependency readiness and both delivery modes to real shared resolution/acquisition. Remove process/release-directory guesses and duplicate trust paths, while keeping lifecycle and migration ports under their existing owners. The future Windows bridge process and its runtime-selection/execution coverage remain owned by main-epic S7; this task exposes the shared foundation for that consumer.
acceptanceChecks: Every existing installed consumer owned by this correction selects the canonical resolved executable from explicit location+manifest identity, verifies actual process.execPath where required, and has no tools/node/PATH/runtimeDirectory trust fallback. S4 daemon boot consumes the real exposed resolver later; no S4 production consumer is required prematurely here. Future S7 bridge-process runtime selection/execution is not a current T8 consumer or a prerequisite to validating this task.

Both delivery preparations acquire only under original controller ownership before lifecycle disruption; installed start/status/receipt resolution never downloads/builds source or traverses full app/Ollama payloads.
S3 runtime readiness uses verified external paths, preserving Ollama consent/retention, agent recommendations, install-only Retry and terminal TUI flow.
S4 boot/lease/shutdown/wrapper and S5 hooks remain consumers, not new implementations; separate manager action-specific peer gating is excluded and missing production peers still fail truthfully.
